_source.title: TM 9-1275 U.S. Rifle, Cal. .30, M1 (transcription, Section 1 Introduction)
_source.locator: Sec. 1, par. 1-5 (par. 5a: cartridge Cal. .30, M2); no printed page numbers on the transcription
_source.note: The manual states only caliber .30 (0.30 in = 7.62 mm); the metric designation 7.62×63 mm for the .30-06 case is a conversion/convention and was not read in the manual itself.

_source.title: TM 9-1275 U.S. Rifle, Cal. .30, M1 (transcription, Section 1 Introduction)
_source.locator: Sec. 1, par. 5a (Cartridge, ball type: Cal. .30, M2)
_source.note: Military nomenclature is Cartridge, Ball, Cal. .30, M2; the commercial name .30-06 Springfield is not used in the page text read.

_source.title: FM 23-5 U.S. Rifle, Caliber .30, M1 (transcription, Chapter 1; post-war edition, edition date not shown on the page)
_source.locator: Ch. 1, par. 3 (clip holds a maximum of eight rounds)
_source.note: Post-war manual; magazine design is unchanged from wartime. Secondary agreement: Lone Sentry M1 Garand page (8 rounds).

_source.title: FM 23-5 U.S. Rifle, Caliber .30, M1 (transcription, Chapter 1)
_source.note: TM 9-1275 par. 5a lists the loading device only as 'Clip'.

_source.title: FM 23-5 U.S. Rifle, Caliber .30, M1 (transcription, Chapter 1; post-war edition)
_source.locator: Ch. 1, par. 4 (muzzle velocity, M2 ammunition: 853 m/s = 2,800 ft/s)
_source.note: Matches the previous value. TM 9-1275 (wartime) does not list muzzle velocity.

_source.title: FM 23-5 U.S. Rifle, Caliber .30, M1 (transcription, Chapter 1; post-war edition)
_source.locator: Ch. 1, par. 4 (maximum effective rate of fire 16 to 24 aimed rounds per minute)
_source.note: Previous value 40 (GAMEDESIGN 6.2, from memory; 40-50 is a commonly quoted unaimed semi-auto rate in secondary literature, not verified here). Upper end of the manual's aimed-fire range is used; the manual states no prescribed maximum.

_source.title: TM 9-1275 U.S. Rifle, Cal. .30, M1 (transcription, Section 1 Introduction)
_source.locator: Sec. 1, par. 5a (weight 9.5 lb, rifle only, unloaded)
_source.note: 9.5 lb = 4.309 kg, rounded to 4.3. With bayonet M1 and sling M1907: 11.2 lb. Same figure in FM 23-5 Ch. 1 par. 4.

_source.title: FM 23-5 U.S. Rifle, Caliber .30, M1 (transcription, Chapter 1; post-war edition)
_source.note: Field newly added by M0-031. Lone Sentry M1 Garand page gives 440 yd (about 402 m), a secondary source with different definition; FM 23-5 preferred.

deviation_reason.gameplay.fire.cap_rpm: Semi-auto pacing cap 120 rpm vs historical practical 16-24 aimed rpm: gameplay cap, not a historical rate (GAMEDESIGN 6.3); unchanged by M0-031.
